contradictions.older_position: Frank components can be functionally complete while state/runtime semantics are implemented in parallel Python/JSON/SQL structures and projected into cognition.
contradictions.current_position: Owner-fixed Clay Machine requires one Clay-native semantic type/value world across cognition, runtime-relevant state, identity, capability, effect, provenance, outcome and lineage.
contradictions.consequence: Existing functional passes must be rechecked for semantic-boundary compliance; physical implementation languages remain allowed below the boundary.

contradictions.older_position: Physical executable+database unity could be treated as architectural unification evidence.
contradictions.current_position: Semantic unity is fixed, but physical unity neither follows from nor proves semantic/authority unity.
contradictions.consequence: EUDI receives no promotion from the Clay Machine directive; split layout remains a mandatory control and may win.

contradictions.older_position: PR261/V17 outcome->reentry->DONE could be read as closing effect authority.
contradictions.current_position: Target evidence supports a merged partial gate, but real provider timeout-after-acceptance, compiled WP04 path, ordinary production route non-bypassability, canonical support binding and final terminal receipt remain open.
contradictions.consequence: No whole-effect-authority or whole-Frank acceptance claim.

contradictions.older_position: Source/epoch/generation metadata can uniquely identify continuing self.root state.
contradictions.current_position: Same-source/same-metadata sibling states can diverge; target semantic-twin CAS selected one successor but only within its surviving selected-head failure domain.
contradictions.consequence: CAS is a candidate identity-continuity primitive, not production identity authority by itself.

contradictions.older_position: Target SQLite semantic version observation plus short recovery probes may be sufficient recovery metadata.
contradictions.current_position: Upstream documents a 2026 WAL-reset race affecting the observed 3.45.1 version family unless a relevant distro backport exists; current Ubuntu backport state is unresolved.
contradictions.consequence: Do not promote WAL-backed recovery evidence on version-string assumptions.

contradictions.older_position: Higher-order Hyperposition sophistication is presumptively beneficial to Frank topology.
contradictions.current_position: Recent anti-echo/hypofusion weakens Hyperposition as a default; it must beat pairwise/simpler projections on a specified invariant/outcome under budget.
contradictions.consequence: TypedIR/lowering feasibility is not architecture-value evidence.

contradictions.older_position: GWT integration/ignition or reboot-focus persistence may indicate stronger workspace continuity.
contradictions.current_position: Recent tests falsified reboot focus echo and rejected sibling quorum; only complete causal receiver-use/outcome/reentry receipt chains support workspace causal claims.
contradictions.consequence: No averaging negative evidence into an integration score.
